test.quadrants@1.wgsl: struct P { level: f32, alpha: f32 } @group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> p: P; @group(0) @binding(1) var target_image: texture_storage_2d<rgba8unorm, write>; @compute @workgroup_size(8, 8) fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3u) { let size = textureDimensions(target_image); if (id.x >= size.x || id.y >= size.y) { return; } let right = id.x * 2u >= size.x; let bottom = id.y * 2u >= size.y; var c = vec3f(1.0, 0.0, 0.0); if (right && !bottom) { c = vec3f(0.0, 1.0, 0.0); } if (!right && bottom) { c = vec3f(0.0, 0.0, 1.0); } if (right && bottom) { c = vec3f(1.0, 1.0, 1.0); } textureStore(target_image, vec2i(id.xy), vec4f(c * p.level * p.alpha, p.alpha)); }

test.gray16@1.wgsl: struct P { level: f32, alpha: f32 } @group(0) @binding(0) var<uniform> p: P; @group(0) @binding(1) var target_image: texture_storage_2d<rgba16float, write>; @compute @workgroup_size(8, 8) fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) id: vec3u) { let size = textureDimensions(target_image); if (id.x >= size.x || id.y >= size.y) { return; } textureStore(target_image, vec2i(id.xy), vec4f(p.level, p.level, p.level, 1.0)); }
